Nora (Product): quick design/ops question from compliance: folks are confused where to look for 'Region' vs 'Key owner'. Should we turn Region into a persistent header badge or leave everything inside the Data protection card? mock: https://rwd.example/s/residency-badge :thinking:
Kai (Design): header badge is more discoverable, but we risk header clutter. alternative: compact region badge in header + full details in the Data protection card so context is preserved.
Dev (Frontend): tradeoff: making Region global means fetching region metadata on many routes. We can lazy-load to avoid perf hit but there's a flicker. Backend returns retention_seconds or null => frontend currently renders "30 days" when null. Need explicit copy: "Default retention: 30 days" vs "Retention: 7 days (overridden)".
Imani (A11y): a11y concerns: if Region moves to header we must not lose semantic relation to Data protection. Use aria-describedby linking the badge to the data protection heading. Also tooltips must be keyboard operable (button role + aria-expanded) and any encryption toggle must announce via aria-live polite: "Encryption set to Managed key (AcmeCorp)".
Nora (Product): proposal: header shows "Region: US‑West" pill (tooltip: "Primary storage region for this account"). Data protection card shows a compact row: "Encryption: Managed key — AcmeCorp  Manage" so ownership stays contextual.
Kai (Design): I'll push narrow/wide mocks. For audit rows I propose showing local time with a slim timezone token (e.g. "2025-10-02 09:12 — PDT") and hover reveals UTC: "2025-10-02 16:12 UTC".
Dev (Frontend): implementable. For exports, backend currently outputs UTC only. Product asks for both local + UTC columns. Plan: change CSV headers from "timestamp" to "timestamp_local","timestamp_utc" and add a short helper next to the Download button: "CSV includes local and UTC timestamps".
Imani (A11y): export dialog must announce file format and column schema before download and keyboard focus should land on the primary action. Also make sure screen readers can read column names from the preview.
Nora (Product): approved microcopy: region tooltip -> "Primary storage region for this account"; retention helper -> "Default retention: 30 days (account policy may override)"; export helper -> "CSV includes local and UTC timestamps".
Dev (Frontend): I'll file tickets: RW-4510 header badge + inline key owner; RW-4511 copy + retention null state + aria; RW-4512 audit export: add UTC column & update CSV headers. Will include test steps for no-retention/null state and screen-reader checks.
Kai (Design): pushing updated mocks now, will include narrow breakpoint and compact timezone styling.
Imani (A11y): I'll add a short checklist to RW-4511 covering aria-describedby, aria-live text, keyboard popover behavior, and export dialog announcements.
ci-bot: scheduled deploy window: 2025-10-15 02:00 UTC for non-breaking UI and CSV changes.
Nora (Product): thanks team 44D I'll update the style guide and ping docs for a KB noting the new CSV schema.
